content.short: Competitive mobile MOBA on Ethereum and Sui, blending fast-paced strategy with climate-focused environmental lore.
content.description:
E4C: Final Salvation is a mobile-native MOBA that integrates Web3 mechanics with environmental awareness. Set in a dystopian climate-changed world, players engage in 3v3 strategic battles emphasizing skill. The game features a unique dual-champion system, allowing real-time switching between two champions for tactical flexibility during matches.

As an Ambrus Studio creation, E4C leverages Ethereum and Sui for its ecosystem. E4C Rangers NFTs serve as in-game champions while providing holders with governance benefits. The project uses its immersive lore to educate players on global warming while delivering a competitive Web3 gaming experience.
